mn100:23.1: apissu maṃ bhāradvāja devatā disvā evamāhaṃsu
mn100:23.4: na kālakato samaṇo gotamo apica kālaṃ karotīti.
mn100:23.6: na kālakato samaṇo gotamo napi kālaṃ karoti
mn100:23.7: arahaṃ samaṇo gotamo vihāro tveva so arahato evarūpo hotīti.
mn100:24.3: atha kho maṃ bhāradvāja tā devatā upasaṅkamitvā etadavocuṃ
mn100:24.4: mā kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajji
mn100:24.5: sace kho tvaṃ mārisa sabbaso āhārupacchedāya paṭipajjissasi tassa te mayaṃ dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhoharissāma
mn100:24.8: ahaṃ ceva kho pana sabbaso jaddhukaṃ paṭijāneyyaṃ imā ca kho me devatā dibbaṃ ojaṃ lomakūpehi ajjhohareyyuṃ tāya cāhaṃ yāpeyyaṃ
mn100:24.10: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja tā devatā paccācikkhāmi alanti vadāmi.
mn100:25.2: yannūnāhaṃ thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhareyyaṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsanti.
mn100:25.3: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ.
mn100:25.4: tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja thokaṃ thokaṃ āhāraṃ āhārayato pasataṃ pasataṃ yadi vā muggayūsaṃ yadi vā kulatthayūsaṃ yadi vā kaḷāyayūsaṃ yadi vā hareṇukayūsaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ patto kāyo hoti.
mn100:25.5: seyyathāpi nāma asītikapabbāni vā kāḷapabbāni vā evamevassu me aṅgapaccaṅgāni bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.6: seyyathāpi nāma oṭṭhapadaṃ evamevassu me ānisadaṃ hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.7: seyyathāpi nāma vaṭṭanāvaḷī evamevassu me piṭṭhikaṇṭako uṇṇatāvaṇato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.8: seyyathāpi nāma jajjarasālāya gopāṇasiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti evamevassu me phāsuḷiyo oluggaviluggā bhavanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.9: seyyathāpi nāma gambhīre odapāne udakatārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti evamevassu me akkhikūpesu akkhitārakā gambhīragatā okkhāyikā dissanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.10: seyyathāpi nāma tittikālābu āmakacchinno vātātapena saṃphusito hoti sammilāto evamevassu me sīsacchavi saṃphusitā hoti sammilātā tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.11: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja udaracchaviṃ parimasissāmīti piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ parimasissāmīti udaracchaviṃyeva pariggaṇhāmi yāvassu me bhāradvāja udaracchavi piṭṭhikaṇṭakaṃ allīnā hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.12: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja vaccaṃ vā muttaṃ vā karissāmīti tattheva avakujjo papatāmi tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:25.13: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja imameva kāyaṃ assāsento pāṇinā gattāni anumajjāmi tassa mayhaṃ bhāradvāja pāṇinā gattāni anumajjato pūtimūlāni lomāni kāyasmā papatanti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:26.1: apissu maṃ bhāradvāja manussā disvā evamāhaṃsu kāḷo samaṇo gotamoti.
mn100:26.2: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo sāmo samaṇo gotamoti.
mn100:26.3: ekacce manussā evamāhaṃsu na kāḷo samaṇo gotamo napi sāmo maṅguracchavī samaṇo gotamoti.
mn100:26.4: yāvassu me bhāradvāja parisuddho chavivaṇṇo pariyodāto upahato hoti tāyevappāhāratāya.
mn100:27.2: ye kho keci atītamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyiṃsu etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo
mn100:27.3: yepi keci anāgatamaddhānaṃ samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyissanti etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo
mn100:27.4: yepi keci etarahi samaṇā vā brāhmaṇā vā opakkamikā dukkhā tippā kaṭukā vedanā vediyanti etāvaparamaṃ nayito bhiyyo.
mn100:27.5: na kho panāhaṃ imāya kaṭukāya dukkarakārikāya adhigacchāmi uttariṃ manussadhammā alamariyañāṇadassanavisesaṃ

mn100:28.2: abhijānāmi kho panāhaṃ pitu sakkassa kammante sītāya jambūchāyāya nisinno vivicceva kāmehi vivicca akusalehi dhammehi savitakkaṃ savicāraṃ vivekajaṃ pītisukhaṃ paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja viharitā
mn100:28.3: siyā nu kho eso maggo bodhiyāti.
mn100:29.2: kinnu kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yantaṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehīti.
mn100:29.4: na kho ahaṃ tassa sukhassa bhāyāmi yantaṃ sukhaṃ aññatreva kāmehi aññatra akusalehi dhammehīti.
mn100:30.2: na kho taṃ sukaraṃ sukhaṃ adhigantuṃ evaṃ adhimattakasimānaṃ pattakāyena
mn100:30.3: yannūnāhaṃ oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhareyyaṃ odanaṃ kummāsanti.
mn100:30.4: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanaṃ kummāsaṃ.
mn100:30.5: tena kho pana maṃ bhāradvāja samayena pañca bhikkhū paccupaṭṭhitā honti
mn100:30.6: yaṃ no samaṇo gotamo dhammaṃ adhigamissati tanno ārocessatīti.
mn100:30.7: yato kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āhāresiṃ odanaṃ kummāsaṃ atha me te pañca bhikkhū nibbijja pakkamiṃsu
mn100:30.8: bāhulliko samaṇo gotamo padhānavibbhanto āvatto bāhullāyāti.
mn100:31-33.1: so kho ahaṃ bhāradvāja oḷārikaṃ āhāraṃ āharitvā balaṃ gahetvā vivicceva kāmehi …pe… paṭhamaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ
mn100:31-33.2: vitakkavicārānaṃ vūpasamā ajjhattaṃ sampasādanaṃ cetaso ekodibhāvaṃ avitakkaṃ avicāraṃ samādhijaṃ pītisukhaṃ dutiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ pītiyā ca virāgā upekkhako ca vihāsiṃ sato ca sampajāno sukhañca kāyena paṭisaṃvedesiṃ yantaṃ ariyā ācikkhanti upekkhako satimā sukhavihārīti
mn100:31-33.3: tatiyaṃ jhānaṃ upasampajja vihāsiṃ sukhassa ca pahānā dukkhassa ca pahānā pubbeva somanassadomanassānaṃ atthaṅgamā adukkhamasukhaṃ upekkhāsatipārisuddhiṃ
mn100:34.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammiye ṭhite āneñjappatte pubbenivāsānussatiñāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:34.2: so anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi seyyathīdaṃ ekampi jātiṃ dvepi jātiyo …pe… iti sākāraṃ sauddesaṃ anekavihitaṃ pubbenivāsaṃ anussarāmi.
mn100:35.1: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja rattiyā paṭhame yāme paṭhamā vijjā adhigatā
mn100:35.2: avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn100:36-38.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte sattānaṃ cutūpapātañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:36-38.2: so dibbena cakkhunā visuddhena atikkantamānusakena satte passāmi cavamāne upapajjamānena hīne paṇīte suvaṇṇe dubbaṇṇe sugate duggate yathākammūpage satte pajānāmi …pe…
mn100:36-38.3: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja rattiyā majjhime yāme dutiyā
mn100:36-38.4: vijjā adhigatā avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharato.
mn100:39.1: so evaṃ samāhite citte parisuddhe pariyodāte anaṅgaṇe vigatūpakkilese mudubhūte kammaniye ṭhite āneñjappatte āsavānaṃ khayañāṇāya cittaṃ abhininnāmesiṃ.
mn100:39.2: so idaṃ dukkhanti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ
mn100:39.3: ime āsavāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavasamudayoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhoti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ ayaṃ āsavanirodhagāminī paṭipadāti yathābhūtaṃ abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn100:40.1: tassa mayhaṃ evaṃ jānato evaṃ passato kāmāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha bhavāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha avijjāsavāpi cittaṃ vimuccittha
mn100:40.3: khīṇā jāti vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ nāparaṃ itthattāyāti abbhaññāsiṃ.
mn100:41.1: ayaṃ kho me bhāradvāja rattiyā pacchime yāme tatiyā
mn100:41.2: vijjā adhigatā avijjā vihatā vijjā uppannā tamo vihato āloko uppanno yathātaṃ appamattassa ātāpino pahitattassa viharatoti.
mn100:42.1: evaṃ vutte sagāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca

mn100:42.4: kiṃ nu kho bho gotama atthi devāti.
mn100:42.5: ṭhānaso kho panetaṃ bhāradvāja viditaṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:42.7: devāti. kinnu kho bho gotama atthi devāti puṭṭho samāno ṭhānaso panetaṃ bhāradvāja viditaṃ yadidaṃ atthi devāti vadesi
mn100:42.8: nanu bho gotama evaṃ sante tucchā musā hotīti.
mn100:42.9: atthi devāti bhāradvāja puṭṭho samāno atthi devāti yo vadeyya ṭhānaso viditā me viditāti yo vadeyya.
mn100:42.10: atha khvettha viññūpurisena ekaṃsena niṭṭhaṃ gantuṃ vā yadidaṃ
mn100:42.12: kissa pana me bhavaṃ gotamo ādikeneva na byākāsīti.
mn100:42.13: uccena sammataṃ kho etaṃ bhāradvāja lokasmiṃ yadidaṃ
mn100:43.1: evaṃ vutte sagāravo māṇavo bhagavantaṃ etadavoca
mn100:43.2: abhikkantaṃ bho gotama abhikkantaṃ bho gotama
mn100:43.3: seyyathāpi bho gotama nikkujjitaṃ vā ukkujjeyya paṭicchannaṃ vā vivareyya mūḷhassa vā maggaṃ ācikkheyya andhakāre vā telapajjotaṃ dhāreyya cakkhumanto rūpāni dakkhantīti evameva bhotā gotamena anekapariyāyena dhammo pakāsito
mn100:43.4: esāhaṃ bhavantaṃ gotamaṃ saraṇaṃ gacchāmi dhammañca bhikkhusaṅghañca
mn100:43.5: upāsakaṃ maṃ bhavaṃ gotamo dhāretu ajjatagge pāṇupetaṃ saraṇaṅgatanti. sagāravasuttaṃ
